anomalies.observed: Net UART_TX contains U5.26 (UART_TXD0) together with many ground pins: J7.1 (the header pin the spec says is GND), U5.17/20/27/30 (GND), U4 GND/AGND pins, IC1.C2 and IC1.A1 (MODE), J2.6 (VSS), J3.4 (GND), J4.2 (sleeve), S1.1, C2.1, C4.1, and the GND-side pads of many capacitors. The net is effectively the ground net, so the SKW92A debug TX pin is hard-wired to GND.
anomalies.expected: Spec: "J7 | Conn_01x03 | Debug UART header | netlist: pin1→GND, pin2→UART_TX (SKW92A pin 26), pin3→UART_RX (SKW92A pin 25)". UART_TX should be an isolated signal net carrying only J7.2 and U5.26, and must not be merged with GND.
anomalies.impact: The SKW92A UART0 transmit pin is shorted to ground. The debug UART cannot transmit, the driver output is clamped to 0 V, and the pin's signal integrity and any logic or drive contention with the module are compromised. Because the net also carries the ground return, it may cause ground-bounce or driver damage.

anomalies.observed: C1 is 0.1uF/16V (footprint C_0805), placed across Display_Power_Switch and the ground-side net, where the other EPD bulk capacitors are 1uF. Its value differs from the 1 µF/6.3 V G1-group part the spec lists for the Display_Power_Switch decoupling position.
anomalies.expected: Spec table: "C1 (G1 group only): 1 µF/6.3 V". The reference circuit's C1 position is 1 µF/6.3 V, and the value here is 0.1 µF.

evidence.quote: C1 (G1 group only): 1 µF/6.3 V | C2 = 1 µF/6.3 V | Matches G1-specific value

anomalies.impact: The EPD supply bulk decoupling on the panel rail is roughly ten times smaller than the reference, which can cause supply ripple and boost-converter instability or panel refresh faults.

anomalies.observed: C11 is a capacitor (Device:C, 0.1uF) but its footprint is Inductor_SMD:L_0805_2012Metric_Pad1.05x1.20mm_HandSolder, and pin 1 sits on a dedicated unconnected net while pin 2 is on the ground net.
anomalies.expected: A capacitor should use a capacitor footprint. A decoupling capacitor should have both pins connected to its rail.
anomalies.impact: The part is a dead, non-functional capacitor on the wrong footprint; it provides no decoupling and may be placed with the wrong land pattern.

parsed.summary: The netlist places the SKW92A debug UART TX pin (U5.26) on a net named UART_TX that is merged with many ground pins, including the J7 header's GND pin. That is a clear short of a signal to ground. Lesser concerns are the EPD bulk capacitor C1 being 0.1 µF instead of the reference 1 µF and a capacitor with an inductor footprint and floating pin (C11).
